DESCRIPTION: A Sennheiser Spectera base station over the Sound Control Protocol, version 2, HTTPS on 443: its packs - name, state, battery, RF and sleep - its two RF channels, its inputs and outputs, its site and its state, all watched as they change. It has no audio mute: muting is the console's. Its login row holds api and the third-party password set in Control Cockpit; its pin the certificate's fingerprint, trusted once shown.

SOURCES: Sennheiser, SPECTERA API v18.3.0 (OpenAPI 3.1, Spectera-openapi-api-18.3.yaml, loaded by docs.cloud.sennheiser.com/en-us/api-docs/spectera/open-api-specification-18-3.html): the paths, the PUT schemas and their required identifiers (SekPut and SkmPut by the discriminator type), RfChannelPut, the read-only site, and the three Basic users - initialSennheiser, controlSennheiser, api (third-party access)
Sennheiser, Spectera API Release Notes 18.3: no audio mute per Mobile Device or Audio I/O; sleep preliminary; the 10 MHz bandwidth not certified

Sennheiser, Sennheiser Sound Control (SSCv2) Specification, version 2.3 (docs.cloud.sennheiser.com): HTTPS and HTTP/1.1 only, the subscription - GET /api/ssc/state/subscriptions as Server-Sent Events, the open event's sessionUUID, PUT .../{sessionUUID}/add with a JSON array of paths, the initial values reported on add, notifications keyed by resource path - and PUT's partial, transactional updates
cross-read, not copied: bitfocus/companion-module-sennheiser-spectera (MIT; Sennheiser's own), its API client: the resources it watches

warnings.DESCRIPTION: Its warnings now, one a value.

deviceName.DESCRIPTION: Its name, as set in Control Cockpit.

location.DESCRIPTION: Its location, as set in Control Cockpit.

position.DESCRIPTION: Its position, as set in Control Cockpit.

channels.DESCRIPTION: The two RF channels, by rfChannelId.

frequency.DESCRIPTION: The channel's frequency in kHz, in steps of 1000, within what /api/rf/restrictions allows.

txPower.DESCRIPTION: The transmit power in mW: 10, 20, 30, 50 or 100.

bandwidthMode.DESCRIPTION: The bandwidth in kHz: 6000 or 8000 as the licence allows; 10000 is taken and never transmits (18.3, Known Issues).

rfStateOnStartup.DESCRIPTION: RF at power-up: on, muted, or as it was.

txPower.DESCRIPTION: The transmit power in mW: 10, 20, 30, 50 or 100.

bandwidthMode.DESCRIPTION: The bandwidth in kHz: 6000 or 8000 as the licence allows; 10000 is taken and never transmits (18.3, Known Issues).

rfStateOnStartup.DESCRIPTION: RF at power-up: on, muted, or as it was.

antennas.DESCRIPTION: The antenna ports, by antennaPortId: state, interference.

all.DESCRIPTION: Every paired pack - SEK bodypack or SKM handheld - by the mtUid the base station gave it; its fields: name, type (SEK or SKM), state (Connected, Disconnected, Syncing, Sleeping, Updating), batteryFillLevel (per cent), batteryRuntime (minutes), batteryLow, rssi (-138 to 30 dBm), micLqi (0 to 4), interference/severity, dominantAntenna, commandState, sleep and identify (writable), micPreampGain (writable: -6 to 42 dB on an SEK, -10 to 42 on an SKM), micLowCutHz, micTestToneEnabled, micTestToneLevel, an SEK's headphoneVolume (-100 to 27.5 in halves) and headphoneBalance, rfChannelId.

inputs.DESCRIPTION: The audio inputs, by inputId: name, inputSource (AoIp, Madi1, Madi2).

outputs.DESCRIPTION: The audio outputs, by outputId: what is routed to each interface.

health.DESCRIPTION: The power supplies and the temperature: psu, tempstateoverall.
